researchPolicy.missingEvidenceRule: A limited-research long-tail candidate may be held for insufficient evidence only after identity, official-site and targeted relevance searches complete.
researchPolicy.oldEvidenceRule: Previous-run evidence is discovery-only until freshly acquired or freshness-validated into the current run snapshot.

eligibilityPolicy.unknownRule: Unknown is not a negative fact and never becomes false solely because retrieval failed.

accountTierPolicy.kaScope: KA is reserved for downstream-channel candidates and is prohibited for a candidate acting in a tier-1 distributor path.

evidenceRules.scoringRequirement: current runId + fresh/revalidated status + matching content hash + non-discovery source
